events.description: Draw the 2D closed loop in the XY plane with a distinct stroke color.
events.clip_query: A 2D closed loop or curve is drawn on a flat plane.

events.description: Render the 3D parametric surface representing the midpoints and lengths of all chords of the loop.
events.clip_query: A 3D surface emerges above the 2D loop, showing varying heights.

events.description: Animate two tracking dots moving along the loop with a connecting chord line.
events.clip_query: Two dots move along the loop with a line segment connecting them.

events.description: Display a tracking dot on the 3D surface that dynamically moves in sync with the chord's midpoint and length.
events.clip_query: A dot moves on the 3D surface, tracking the midpoint and length of the chord below.

events.description: Rotate the 3D camera to show the surface from multiple angles, highlighting its topological structure.
events.clip_query: The camera rotates around the 3D surface to show its shape and height.
